test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Seven students, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). D is sitting second to the left of C. D is sitting to the immediate right of G. B is sitting third to the left of F. E is sitting to the immediate left of B.

Who among the following is an immediate neighbour of B and D?
solution:
Given: Seven students, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) D is sitting second to the left of C.

2) D is sitting to the immediate right of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c8c17fbed3961ec9004e23c19987de9eaaa2fc17ec5ec4aaf73b125db66a5ea.png] 

3) B is sitting third to the left of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4444983aa572f2c90996c943bdc5a5173117f37fa7866780daa8fc35512867b6.png] 

4) E is sitting to the immediate left of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/133ff143c5f45b136b4b076c61be6e60dd2917076868f82857253d168c43674d.png] 

Final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a58a787446a2621acec1ab99a94c9016de33b669285ebd6abbfc820c3506cf0.png] 

So, **G** is an immediate neighbour of B and D.

Hence, the correct answer is** "G".**
